# Contrast

<!-- Generated by `sereno check --markdown`. Do not edit: change the palette in Serena Theme, import it, and generate this file again. -->

Contrast ratios (WCAG 2 relative luminance) of the Serena palette, imported from github.com/joaooliveira10/serena-theme at v1.1.0 (commit a62ecad).
Ratios are rounded to two decimals; whether a pair passes is decided on the exact ratio.

## Slots against the background

Floor: 4.5 for the dark and light variants, 7.0 for the high-contrast ones.
Slot 0 is a surface colour on dark backgrounds and is exempt there.

## Other pairs

The cursor needs 3.0; the other pairs need the floor of their variant.
Windows Terminal draws selected text in black or white, whichever contrasts more; other emulators use the selection foreground.

| Pair | Serena Dark | Serena Dark Vivid | Serena Light | Serena Light Vivid | Serena High Contrast | Serena High Contrast Light |
| :--- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| foreground on background | 12.13 | 12.46 | 10.49 | 10.49 | 17.51 | 19.52 |
| cursor on background | 8.54 | 6.47 | 5.51 | 6.08 | 17.51 | 19.52 |
| selection foreground on selection background | 6.99 | 8.04 | 9.20 | 9.20 | 11.01 | 11.02 |
| black or white on selection background | 10.30 | 11.85 | 15.75 | 15.75 | 11.84 | 11.02 |

## Roles

Everything above the emulator uses SGR parameters for the sixteen slots, never hex values and never a painted background.

| Role | SGR parameters | Allowed |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| function | `34` | yes |
| keyword | `35` | yes |
| string | `32` | yes |
| type | `33` | yes |
| property | `36` | yes |
| constant | `93` | yes |
| parameter | `3;37` | yes |
| operator | `37` | yes |
| variable | `39` | yes |
| default | `39` | yes |
| comment | `90` | yes |
| error | `91` | yes |
| emphasis | `96` | yes |
| selection | `7` | yes |
| prompt.path | `34` | yes |
| prompt.branch | `35` | yes |
| prompt.ok | `32` | yes |
| prompt.failed | `31` | yes |
| prompt.meta | `90` | yes |

## Result

Every value is at or above its floor.
